name: @prova/midnight
description: Prova's Midnight privacy layer — Compact contracts and their tests.

scripts.//build: Recompiles every contract. Output is gitignored: keys are megabytes and regenerate in seconds.
scripts.build: npm run check:toolchain && compact compile contracts/compliance.compact build && compact compile contracts/notes.compact build-notes && compact compile contracts/transfer.compact build-transfer
scripts.//test: Builds first: the tests import the generated contracts, and build output is gitignored, so a fresh clone has nothing to import.
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --types node --skipLibCheck tests/compliance.test.ts tests/harness.ts
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run typecheck && vitest run
scripts.//mutants: Breaks each security check in turn and verifies the tests notice. Slow — eight compile-and-test cycles.
scripts.//bench: Times real proof generation. Needs a proof server on :6300 — see bench/RESULTS.md.
scripts.//deploy: Deploys to a Midnight network. Run deploy:check first — it verifies everything without spending anything.
scripts.//wallet: Generates a deployment wallet and prints the address to fund. Seed goes to .env, never stdout.
